text: Trent Limited has informed the Exchange about intimation of schedule of Analyst / Institutional Investors Meetings
nse_summary: Trent Limited has intimated the schedule of meetings with analysts and institutional investors pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Wasatch Global Advisors and Kotak Mahindra Asset Management Singapore are scheduled for one-to-one meetings on 17th November 2026. CEO Track JM Financial will participate in the 17th Annual Flagship Conference India Xchange 2026 on 18th November 2026. RBC Global Asset Management Asia is scheduled for a one-to-one meeting on 24th November 2026. T. Rowe Price Aayush Kumar will hold a one-to-one meeting on 25th November 2026. JP Morgan Asset Management is scheduled for a one-to-one meeting on 26th November 2026. The schedule is subject to change. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these meetings.
